name: David Bowie

whyMatters.en: Solo artist filed here as a band-node. From Space Oddity (1969) through Ziggy glam, the Berlin albums with Eno, and Let’s Dance (1983), persona and production partners change by era on purpose.
whyMatters.zh: 以乐队节点收录的独唱歌手。从《Space Oddity》（1969）经 Ziggy glam、与 Eno 合作的柏林专辑，到《Let’s Dance》（1983），人设与制作伙伴按时期有意切换。

note.en: Ziggy-era glam; Mick Ronson guitar. Top of the Pops performance widely cited for UK visibility.
note.zh: Ziggy 时期 glam；Mick Ronson 吉他。Top of the Pops 演出常被引用为英国可见度节点。

note.en: Berlin-period track; Fripp guitar feedback beds, Eno treatments, Visconti production.
note.zh: 柏林时期曲目；Fripp 吉他反馈铺底、Eno 处理、Visconti 制作。

note.en: Nile Rodgers production with Stevie Ray Vaughan guitar; major 1980s pop-radio hit.
note.zh: Nile Rodgers 制作，Stevie Ray Vaughan 吉他；1980 年代流行电台重要热单。

interviewQuotes.speaker: David Bowie

interviewQuotes.speaker: David Bowie

lyricQuotes: We can be heroes, just for one day

shortBio.en: Solo node, 1969–2016. Ziggy glam, Berlin trilogy, Let’s Dance; session partners shift with each era.
shortBio.zh: 独唱节点，1969–2016。Ziggy glam、柏林三部曲、《Let’s Dance》；录音室伙伴随时期更换。

body.en:
Career markers run from Space Oddity (1969) through The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars (1972), the Eno collaborations Low and “Heroes” (1977), and Let’s Dance (1983).

In this graph, Bowie matters for planned style and lineup change. Session players and producers—Mick Ronson, Tony Visconti, Brian Eno, Nile Rodgers—are as important as the stage characters.
body.zh:
生涯标记从《Space Oddity》（1969）经《The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars》（1972）、与 Eno 合作的《Low》与《“Heroes”》（1977），到《Let’s Dance》（1983）。

在本图谱里，Bowie 的重点是有计划的风格与阵容切换。录音室乐手与制作人——Mick Ronson、Tony Visconti、Brian Eno、Nile Rodgers——与舞台角色同等重要。

title.zh: 按时期切换的工作方式

body.en:
Filed as a band-node: glam, Berlin, and Let’s Dance eras show planned production and costume changes. Session partners (Ronson, Eno, Fripp, Rodgers) belong in the method, not as side notes.

Change is constant across the catalog.
body.zh:
以乐队节点收录：glam、柏林、Let’s Dance 时期展示有计划的制作与造型切换。录音室伙伴（Ronson、Eno、Fripp、Rodgers）属于工作方式本身，不是旁注。

切换贯穿整份目录。

body.en:
Lineup versions here mean era teams: Spiders from Mars (Ziggy), Eno/Fripp/Visconti (Berlin), Rodgers/Vaughan (Let’s Dance). Same name; different studio fingerprints.

Use the versions as production chapters.
body.zh:
此处阵容版本即时期团队：Spiders from Mars（Ziggy）、Eno/Fripp/Visconti（柏林）、Rodgers/Vaughan（Let’s Dance）。同一名字；不同录音室指纹。

把版本当制作章节用。

body.en:
The Ziggy Stardust cycle uses Ronson’s guitar and string arrangements with Bowie’s character vocal. The Top of the Pops performance is a UK media marker for glam visibility.

Space Oddity (1969) remains the earlier chart entry.
body.zh:
Ziggy Stardust 周期使用 Ronson 吉他与弦乐编排，以及 Bowie 的角色人声。Top of the Pops 演出是英国 glam 可见度的媒体标记。

《Space Oddity》（1969）仍是更早的榜单入口。

body.en:
Low and “Heroes” (with Eno) foreground ambient beds, Fripp feedback, and Visconti production. The vocal sits inside texture more than arena melisma.

Punk and post-punk neighbors cite this period’s cool more often than Ziggy glitter.
body.zh:
《Low》与《“Heroes”》（与 Eno）突出氛围铺底、Fripp 反馈与 Visconti 制作。人声坐在纹理里，而非体育场花腔。

朋克与后朋克邻域更多引用这一时期的冷感，而非 Ziggy 闪光。

body.en:
Circulated lines emphasize change and constructed stardom. Pair them with named producers and session players on the records.

Quotes are posture evidence beside the credits.
body.zh:
流传短句强调切换与建构出的明星身份。对照唱片上具名制作人与录音室乐手。

引语是姿态证据，与署名并列。

body.en:
Radiohead and later alternative acts cite Berlin-era studio work. Punk and glam both claim pieces of the costume history.

In this graph: deliberate era change as catalog structure.
body.zh:
Radiohead 与后来 alternative 引用柏林时期录音室工作。朋克与 glam 都认领戏服史的一部分。

在本图谱：有意的时期切换即目录结构。

note.en: Glam character cycle; Hunky Dory through Aladdin Sane.
note.zh: Glam 角色周期；从《Hunky Dory》到《Aladdin Sane》。

note.en: Low / “Heroes” / Lodger; texture and ambient beds.
Major pop-radio scale; funk-rock production with Rodgers.
note.zh: 大型流行电台尺度；与 Rodgers 的放克摇滚制作。

note.en: Early UK chart single; Major Tom as recurring character.
note.zh: 早期英国榜单单曲；Major Tom 作为反复出现的角色。

note.en: Persona and production partners change by era on purpose.
note.zh: 人设与制作伙伴按时期有意切换。
